_comment: JIRA profile, written against the `jira` CLI (ankitpokhrel/jira-cli). Swap the command strings for `curl` + REST calls if your org standardises on that — only these strings change, no template edits. ${ID} is a full issue key (PROJ-123), NOT a bare number.

tracker.TRACKER_LIST_ISSUES: jira issue list --plain --no-headers -q 'statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC'
tracker.TRACKER_LOCK_MECHANISM: a JIRA label plus assignment to the agent account — JIRA has no atomic label-add, so the acquire is a compare-and-set on the assignee field and the label is the human-readable signal (see notes)
tracker.TRACKER_LOCK_ACQUIRE: jira issue assign ${ID} ${JIRA_AGENT_ACCOUNT} && jira issue edit ${ID} --label ${LABEL} --no-input
tracker.TRACKER_LOCK_RELEASE: jira issue edit ${ID} --label -${LABEL} --no-input && jira issue assign ${ID} x

notes: LOCK SEMANTICS DIFFER FROM GITHUB — read before relying on parallel agents. GitHub's mutex works because a label add is atomic server-side. JIRA's label edit is a read-modify-write on the issue's label array and is NOT atomic: two agents can both read an unlabelled issue and both write their label, and both will believe they hold the lock. The assignee field is the compare-and-set surface instead — assignment is a single-valued field, so the second writer overwrites rather than merges, and the acquire must be VERIFIED by re-reading the assignee after writing it. An agent that assigns and then reads back a different account has LOST the race and must abort.

Practical consequence: TRACKER_LOCK_ACQUIRE above is not sufficient on its own for a parallel fleet. Either (a) follow it with a read-back verification step, (b) run agents serially, or (c) replace it with a REST call using an If-Match / version precondition. The workflow prose renders TRACKER_LOCK_MECHANISM so the reader is told which of these applies rather than inheriting GitHub's assumption silently.

Status names are per-project workflow transitions, not a fixed set. The workflow's status table maps to whatever your project defines — edit the rendered board/status prose once after the first render.

Smart-commit keywords (Closes PROJ-123) require the JIRA/VCS integration to be installed on the code host. If it is not, TRACKER_CLOSE_KEYWORD still renders harmlessly as plain text but nothing auto-transitions — set it to empty string and close via TRACKER_CLOSE_ISSUE in the cleanup step instead.

extraVars.JIRA_BASE_URL: Set in your environment or replace inline after render, e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net
extraVars.JIRA_AGENT_ACCOUNT: Account id the agent fleet assigns issues to while holding the lock
